description: Synthetic CRM support cases for the P6 leak test. Every name, address, number and email is invented (555-01xx phones, example.com/example.org mail, published test card numbers). 'planted' lists values that must never appear in the knowledge store, logs, reports or retrieval results.

cases.title: Cradle not charging AX-200 handset
cases.description:
Hi Support,
My AX-200 sits in the cradle overnight and the light never turns green. Please call me on 555-010-3344 or mail dana.w@example.com.
Thanks, Dana Whitfield
--
Dana Whitfield
Warehouse lead, 41 Elm Street, Springfield
555-010-3344
notes: Spoke with Dana: cradle LED is solid amber, handset LED off.
Technician: Marcus Lee checked the cradle contacts, they were dirty. Case CAS-20931 linked.
cases.resolution: Cleaned the cradle charging contacts with isopropyl alcohol and reseated the handset. Charging resumed within ten minutes; the indicator turned green after two hours.

cases.title: Scanner trigger does nothing after a drop
cases.description:
From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@example.org>
Sent: Monday
Subject: scanner broken

Hello, the scan trigger stopped working after the unit fell off a cart. My number is +1 (555) 010-7781.
notes: Called Priya, trigger feels loose. Invoice INV-88123 attached for proof of purchase.
Asked customer to test the soft-trigger in the settings menu: soft-trigger works, so the imager is fine.
cases.resolution: Hardware trigger switch was dislodged by the impact. Advised a paid repair under the impact-damage exclusion; the soft-trigger is a workaround until then.

cases.title: Unit reboots in a loop after firmware update
cases.description:
Dear team, since last night's update the unit restarts every two minutes. I paid for priority service with card 4111 1111 1111 1111.
Regards, Morgan Ellery (m.ellery@example.net)
notes: Agent: Olivia Chen walked the customer through a recovery boot (hold power + scan for 15 s).
Firmware reflashed to the previous release from recovery mode.
cases.resolution: Rolled back to the previous firmware via recovery boot, then applied the corrected update. No reboots in a 24 hour soak.

cases.title: Bluetooth drops when walking away from host
cases.description: Hi, shipping address for any swap is 2210 Harrison Street, Oakland. Order ORD-55120. The handset loses its Bluetooth link at about 8 metres.
notes: Customer Tomas Brandt also has a spare unit ZX9-4410-7731 that behaves the same.
Found a metal shelving rack between host and handset; moving the host improved range.
cases.resolution: Relocated the Bluetooth host above the shelving and re-paired. Link now holds to 25 metres.

cases.title: Screen flicker, still investigating

notes: Waiting for a replacement display assembly.
